comments.author: Gabe Perez
comments.text:
Hey Product Hunt 👋  

Every launch on Product Hunt starts in our submission flow, and for a long time that meant a step-by-step form. You filled in one step at a time, opened a preview to see how it looked, then went back through the steps to find whatever was missing.  

Today we're upgrading it with a visual launch editor. You can now build your launch on a page that looks like your launch, and you edit anything by clicking on it.

Here's what's new:

*   **Start with your link.** Paste your website link, and we bring in the details and media we can find. You can edit them before launching.
    
*   **Edit in place.** Name, tagline, description, gallery, links, pricing, tags, makers, shoutouts and your first comment are all edited right on the page.
    
*   **See your edits, LIVE!** The editor is now visual, so you can see exactly how your launch will look as you make changes.
    
*   **A launch checklist.** It sorts everything into Required, Needs attention and Make it stand out, and Fix links open the exact field that's blocking you.
    
*   **Better tag discovery.** Get suggestions based on your description, or browse every launch tag from A to Z.

Hi [@rajsb\_](https://www.producthunt.com/@rajsb_) (Raj),

Thanks for the new visual launch editor. I tested it and wanted to share a few bugs and UX observations.

**1\. Additional links don’t appear on first-time launches**

When a maker adds additional links to a first-time launch, only the first link appears on the launch page; the rest are hidden.

For example, if a product has separate web, iOS, and Android links, makers may add all of them but visitors will only see the first one.

This works differently for repeat launches: once the launch post is embedded on the product page, all additional links show up.

Could additional links also be displayed for first-time launches, so makers don’t assume their links are missing or that adding them has no effect?

**2\. Category tags are no longer auto-suggested**

Previously, category tags could be added automatically if the product page wasn’t edited. Now they have to be selected manually.

Since the category list is long and can be overwhelming, especially for first-time makers, it would be helpful to auto-suggest or pre-fill relevant categories based on the product description, while still allowing makers to change them.

This will also help the SEO / GEO efforts of the platform.

**3\. Drafts aren’t visible in “My Products”**

The editor appears to auto-save, and the top of the page indicates that I’m working in a draft. However, when I go to **My Products**, it shows **zero drafts**, and I can’t find an explicit “Save draft” option or a way to reopen the draft later.

Could you confirm whether I’m missing a button, or restore a visible way to save and access drafts?

In the previous flow, there was a save draft option, and you could see your launch draft as it would look on the launch day without having the edit buttons all over.

Happy to test anything further or share more details if useful. Thanks again!

comments.author: Edward Chen
comments.text:
Hi Product Hunt 👋

I’m one of the makers behind MOVO AI—the world’s first long-form video agent on your mobile.

My mother is a small creator who manages several social media accounts, and my father is her loyal cameraman. They are both over 60, but they still spend hours filming, editing, posting, and proudly watching every new like and follower.

They make little, if any, money from it. But social media gives them something real: an audience, confidence, and the feeling that their stories are being seen.

At the same time, I watched more founders around me become creators. They recorded videos between meetings, explained their ideas to customers, and built influence around themselves and their products.

I was different. I was an introverted engineer who began working in AI while completing my graduate degree at Carnegie Mellon University. I had ideas, but I didn’t understand camera movements, editing, or how to look natural on camera. Even with the newest iPhone, I often didn’t know where to begin.

My parents showed me how meaningful it could be to share your life. The founders around me showed me how necessary video was becoming. Together, they made me feel like I was being left behind by an era I was helping to build.

That gap became the reason we built MOVO AI.

**What is MOVO?**

MOVO turns an idea into a complete long-form video through one continuous conversation.

Start with a rough thought, script, reference, or a few assets. MOVO helps structure the story, establish the characters and visual direction, generate scenes, respond to feedback, and compose everything into a cohesive video.

You don’t need to know the technical name of every shot or write a complex prompt for each scene. You can simply talk to MOVO as you would talk to a director, creative partner, or friend.

Internally, we describe it as “Codex for video”: you direct what you want to create without writing every underlying instruction yourself.

**What surprised us**

We initially thought eliminating prompt gymnastics would mainly help beginners. Professional AI creators already knew how to write sophisticated prompts, select models, and manage complicated workflows.

We underestimated how much professionals would value this approach too.

They embraced it not because they couldn’t write prompts, but because they wanted to focus their attention on what matters more: story, structure, pacing, characters, and emotion.

Conversations with accomplished professors and screenwriters at USC’s School of Cinematic Arts reinforced this belief. Models and production tools will keep changing, but storytelling remains the foundation.

We realized that agentic creation is not simply an easier mode for beginners. It may be a more universal creative interface: accessible enough for a first-time creator, yet powerful enough to free professionals from repetitive production work.

**Why mobile matters**

Once creation becomes conversational, it no longer needs to live inside a desktop canvas.

A founder can start a product video before the next meeting. A store owner can review an advertisement from behind the counter. A parent can develop a family story in the park. A filmmaker can approve scenes while moving between locations. A hiker can capture an idea at the summit before the inspiration disappears.

You might describe an idea over breakfast, approve the storyboard on the train, review generated scenes after work, and refine the ending before bed.

MOVO continues working asynchronously, so you don’t need to babysit every generation. Creation can move with your life instead of requiring your life to stop.

**From one video to an ongoing world**

Within the same project, you can begin Episodes 2, 3, and 4 in new sessions without re-entering the same characters, products, locations, and creative direction.

MOVO carries that context forward, helping you develop an ongoing world rather than a collection of disconnected clips.

**What we’d love you to test**

We would especially value feedback on three things:

1.  Does talking to MOVO feel like working with a useful director or creative partner?
    
2.  Can you meaningfully develop a video on mobile without supervising every step?
    
3.  How well does MOVO preserve your creative world across multiple episodes?
    

AI video still has many unsolved problems, and MOVO is still evolving. We want to hear where it understands your direction, where it surprises you, and where it falls short.

Our goal is not to replace human creativity. It is to close the gap between having a story and being able to show it.

Anyone with a story should be able to make it move—wherever life takes them.

Your idea. Moved by MOVO. 🎬

comments.author: Oleksii Sekundant
comments.text:
Likely AI

The endpoint view is the interesting bit for me. A tool can be popular because of one useful endpoint, and that detail gets lost in a product-level ranking.





![Gal Dayan](https://ph-avatars.imgix.net/9882085/original.jpeg?auto=compress,format&codec=mozjpeg&cs=strip&fit=crop&frame=1&h=48&w=48)

[Gal Dayan](https://www.producthunt.com/@galdayan)


•[212 reviews](https://www.producthunt.com/@galdayan/reviews)

#### What's great

one key for 1,800 APIs instead of separately signing up, testing, and billing for each provider is a genuinely big time save if you're building anything agent-based. the fact that the agent itself can search the catalog and pick a tool by price/reliability/performance at runtime, instead of you hardcoding which API to call, fits how agent workflows actually behave in practice - the right tool for a task isn't always known ahead of time.

#### What needs improvement

not clear from the launch page whether there's a spend cap or budget ceiling per agent/key - with 1,800 paid APIs behind one key, a bad retry loop or stuck agent could rack up a real bill before a human notices. a hard per-key spend limit would make this much safer to hand to something fully autonomous.

#### vs Alternatives


Merge is built for syncing your own app's data models across customer SaaS tools (CRM, HRIS, etc) - it's an integrations layer for a product you're building. Monid is a different shape of problem: giving an autonomous agent runtime access to a huge catalog of external tools and data sources on demand, not wiring fixed integrations into your own backend ahead of time.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋 Back in April we launched Ovren here — you describe a coding task in plain words, and it comes back as a pull request your team reviews. Thank you for the #4 of the day. The most common thing we heard after that launch: "I trust the pull request… but I can't read code. How do I know it's what I asked for?" So today we're launching Live Preview. Here's how it works: 1. Connect your GitHub project (one GitHub App install) 2. Describe the change — "add a testimonials section under the hero, matching our card style" 3. Ovren plans it, you approve the plan, it writes the code on a safe copy of your project 4. You get a live preview — your real page, with the change on it. Click through it like a visitor would 5. Happy? Approve it, and your developers review and merge the pull request. Not happy? Request changes. No localhost, no install, no deploy. Ovren builds the preview on its side. What it's for: → Marketers and founders who want to see a landing section, banner or form before asking anyone to merge it → PMs who want to show stakeholders a working version, not a mockup → Developers who'd rather click through a change than read a diff of someone else's request To be upfront: live preview covers frontend changes. Backend work still comes as a pull request with a full execution report — what Ovren understood, the files it changed and any risks it flagged. You can try it free — up to 5 changes, no credit card. I'd love to hear what you'd ship first, and what would make you trust a preview enough to approve it. I'm here all day 🙌

수백 건의 작업을 지켜보며 저희가 배운 가장 큰 교훈은 바로 이것이었습니다: 코드를 읽을 수 없는 사람이라면 PR을 어떻게 승인할 수 있을까요? 마케터, 창업자, 비개발 프로덕트 매니저는 작업을 요청하지만 브랜치를 체크아웃하고 로컬에서 실행하여 확인하기 전까지는 실제로 무엇이 바뀌었는지 알 수 없습니다.

그래서 오늘 저희는 **라이브 프리뷰(Live Preview)**를 출시합니다.

동작 방식:
1. GitHub 저장소를 연결합니다.
2. 원하는 변경 사항을 설명합니다: '블로그 헤더를 네이비 블루로 변경하고 뉴스레터 가입 상자를 추가해 줘.'
3. Ovren이 코드베이스를 읽고 격리된 환경에서 작업을 수행합니다.
4. 준비되면 브라우저에서 변경 사항이 적용된 실제 라이브 페이지가 열립니다. 일반 방문자처럼 직접 클릭하며 테스트해 볼 수 있습니다.
5. 마음에 드시나요? 승인하시면 개발자가 풀 리퀘스트를 검토하고 머지합니다. 마음에 들지 않으신다면 추가 수정을 요청하세요.

로컬호스트도, 설치도, 배포도 필요 없습니다. Ovren이 자체적으로 프리뷰를 빌드합니다.

이 기능의 대상:
→ 배포 전 랜딩 섹션, 배너, 폼을 직접 클릭해보고 싶은 마케터와 창업자
→ 목업 대신 실제로 동작하는 버전을 이해관계자에게 보여주고 싶은 PM
→ 다른 사람의 요청에 대한 diff 코드를 읽는 것보다 직접 클릭해 확인하는 걸 선호하는 개발자

솔직히 말씀드리면, 현재 라이브 프리뷰는 프론트엔드 변경에 적용됩니다. 백엔드 작업은 Ovren이 무엇을 이해했고 어떤 파일을 수정했으며 어떤 위험을 플래그했는지 담긴 전체 실행 보고서와 함께 여전히 풀 리퀘스트로 제공됩니다.

신용카드 등록 없이 최대 5개의 변경 작업을 무료로 체험해 보실 수 있습니다. 여러분이 가장 먼저 배포해보고 싶은 작업이 무엇인지, 어떤 점이 있어야 안심하고 프리뷰를 승인할 수 있을지 의견을 듣고 싶습니다. 오늘 하루 종일 답변드리겠습니다 🙌

**How I met the maker**

I’ve known Mikita since his first launch on Product Hunt, and it’s been great to watch Ovren’s progress since then.

**What is the product**

Ovren helps you make real changes to your websites and apps using AI, without needing to write code. With today’s Live Preview launch, you can describe the change you want, see it on your actual page before it ships, and then create a pull request once everything looks right.

**Why I endorse it**

What I like most about Ovren is that it makes shipping changes easier for non-technical teams while still keeping developers in control through reviewable pull requests.

The team has worked hard on this, and I’d definitely recommend checking out Ovren and sharing your feedback!

comments.author: Rohan Chaubey
comments.text:
**Eleven Realtime** is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for building voice agents that sound natural in conversation.

**Problem:** Voice agents are usually stitched together from separate parts: speech recognition, a language model, turn-taking logic and a voice. Each hand-off adds delay, and that’s where conversations start to feel stiff, with awkward pauses and talking over each other.

**Solution:** Eleven Realtime tunes speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice end to end. It comes in two models. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, and v1 Max is built for complex tasks that need precise, deliberate answers. You can use it in ElevenAgents or through a Realtime API.

**What makes it different:** The API is OpenAI-compatible, so if you already have a voice app built on OpenAI’s Realtime API, you change the endpoint and model name and your existing event handlers keep working. Per ElevenLabs, time to first audio is 620 ms for v1 Mini and 570 ms for v1 Max, across 90+ languages.

**Key features:**

*   v1 Mini for assistants, tutors and interactive characters
    
*   v1 Max for lead qualification, customer support and scheduling
    
*   Pick the model from one dropdown in ElevenAgents, with transcription, turn-taking and voice preconfigured
    
*   Deploy to phone, web widget, WhatsApp and contact center platforms
    
*   Knowledge base, guardrails, scripted scenario testing and production monitoring in ElevenAgents
    
*   Searchable, auditable conversation logs
    
*   Per ElevenLabs, SOC 2, HIPAA and GDPR support, with EU Data Residency and Zero Retention modes
    

**Who it’s for:** Developers and teams building voice agents for support, sales, scheduling or education who want natural-sounding conversations without wiring the pieces together themselves.

Try it via [Eleven Realtime](https://elevenlabs.io/realtime), the [docs](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/customization/realtime-models) and the [OpenAI compatibility guide](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/guides/openai-realtime-compatibility).

**문제점:** 기존의 음성 에이전트는 일반적으로 음성 인식, 언어 모델, 턴 테이킹 로직, 음성 합성이라는 별개의 부품들을 엮어서 만들어집니다. 각각의 단계를 거칠 때마다 지연 시간이 추가되며, 이로 인해 어색한 침묵이 생기거나 서로 말이 겹치면서 대화가 부자연스러워지기 시작합니다.

**차별점:** API가 OpenAI와 호환되므로 이미 OpenAI의 Realtime API를 기반으로 구축된 음성 앱이 있다면 엔드포인트와 모델 이름만 바꾸면 기존 이벤트 핸들러가 그대로 동작합니다. ElevenLabs에 따르면 90개 이상의 언어에서 첫 오디오까지의 시간이 v1 Mini는 620ms, v1 Max는 570ms에 불과합니다.

**주요 기능:**
* 비서, 튜터, 대화형 캐릭터를 위한 v1 Mini
* 리드 검증, 고객 지원, 일정 조정을 위한 v1 Max

* ElevenAgents 내 지식 베이스, 가드레일, 스크립트 시나리오 테스트 및 프로덕션 모니터링

**대상 사용자:** 여러 부품을 직접 조립할 필요 없이 자연스러운 대화를 제공하는 지원, 영업, 일정 관리, 교육용 음성 에이전트를 구축하려는 개발자 및 팀.
